    "Powerful database features for tracking tasks and information"

  "cons": [
    "Can have a steep learning curve for new users",
    "Occasional performance slowdowns with large workspaces",
    "Easy to over-customize, leading to complexity if not managed well"
  ],
  "overall_experience": "This Project Manager likely found Notion to be a significant upgrade from OneNote, appreciating its robust capabilities for organizing and tracking notes and documentation. The platform's flexibility allowed them to tailor it precisely to their project management workflows within the retail industry. While initially overwhelming, the investment in learning paid off, making it an indispensable tool despite occasional performance hiccups."
